build: lean to average, carries herself with quiet purpose — not aspirationally fit, but clearly health-conscious
skin_register: natural pores, minimal makeup, faint under-eye shadows that concealer hasn't fully covered, light fine lines at the corners of eyes — lived-in but cared-for
hair: shoulder to collarbone length, natural texture, warm brunette or dark blonde with minimal styling — pulled loosely back or half-tucked, not polished
wardrobe: fitted slate-grey scoop-neck tee in a quality cotton-modal blend, or a structured but soft oatmeal henley — nothing branded, nothing sloppy — the kind of piece that costs $60 and looks effortlessly considered
accessories: simple gold or silver stud earrings, slim tracker watch on left wrist — Whoop or Garmin — no statement jewelry
expression: brow slightly furrowed in mid-thought, lips pressed together with a faint wry pull at one corner — the face of someone who has heard a claim before and is deciding whether to believe it this time
body_language: weight slightly forward, chin level, one hand resting near jaw or collarbone — alert but not performative, the posture of someone reading a study rather than posing for a photo
register: informed skeptic on the edge of cautious hope — quietly frustrated researcher, not defeated, not sold yet
